notes.title: Playtest Version Released！
notes.notes:
Dear Rhythm Hotel Travelers

Our hotel is still under construction. To collect your valuable feedback and further refine the game, we’ve opened 3 levels in the Playtest version! Simply request, and you’ll receive playtest access.
[olist]
Philosophy on Donkey-kicking

New Oath of the Peach Garden

Scientific Snapshots
[/olist]
Before our game release, we’ll regularly review your feedback and incorporate it into future updates. Maintenance and upgrades will occur periodically.

Our team is working tirelessly to accelerate progress and open Rhythm Hostel’s doors to travelers worldwide as soon as possible!

Your input is essential! Keep sharing your experiences and ideas through our Discord community.
